title: Entity On Target Acquired
description: Adds a trigger to call when this entity finds a target.

event.title: Event
event.description:
The event to run when the conditions for this trigger are met.

Sample values:
• cave_spider: minecraft:become_angry
• drowned: minecraft:has_target
• llama: minecraft:mad_at_wolf

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description:
Filters allow data objects to specify test criteria which allows their use. Filters can be defined by a single object of type (Filter Test), an array of tests, collection groups, or a combination of these objects.

Sample values:
• llama: {"all_of":[{"test":"is_family","subject":"targe...

target.title: FilterSubject
target.description:
The target of the event.

Sample values:
• drowned: self
